caption: The learning algorithm uses the 1000 training emails to build the model: spam if 'lottery' ≥ 2. The 10 test emails are only used to measure accuracy, which is 8 correct out of 10 = 0.8, or 80%.

spec.title: Spam filter: worked example
spec.aria: A flow diagram: training set of 1000 emails (200 spam, 800 not spam) goes to a learning algorithm, which produces the model 'spam if lottery ≥ 2'. The model and a test set of 10 emails both feed into accuracy, computed as 8/10 = 0.8 = 80%.
